reason: This plugin is primarily a user-facing visualization plugin for DeepSeek Harness that augments the web UI with a Minecraft-style HUD and mode icons to display token consumption, cache hit rate, estimated cost, and balance, while periodically updating those values; evidence for this is in the README feature list and technical notes.

summaries.zh: mc-hud 是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在界面内提供 Minecraft 风格 HUD，用于可视化显示解码速率、缓存命中率、估算消费与剩余额度。
summaries.en: mc-hud is a DeepSeek Harness web plugin that adds a Minecraft-style HUD to visualize decode speed, cache hit rate, estimated cost, and remaining balance.

capabilities: Displays token usage and cost-related metrics in a web HUD within DeepSeek Harness
Shows remaining balance and estimated session consumption from DeepSeek billing data
Replaces/extends conversation UI elements for preset mode visuals
Refreshes usage and balance data on periodic timers
Uses configured DeepSeek API key context when querying balance

reasons.code: HUD renders decode speed (tok/s), balance, cache hit rate, and session cost in sidebar/header UI slots.
Host-side description states balance is fetched through DEEPSEEK_API_KEY and shell-based curl request, while also using session projection stats.
Plugin is registered as a DeepSeek Harness client plugin targeting the web platform and exposes client/server entry points.
